casts.text:
💡 The Web3 + AI Daily #61 is all about agentic payments and the various ways in which we slowly, but surely approach the dawn of a true machine-to-machine economy 👇 

👉 @moonpay just open-sourced Open Wallet Standard (OWS) - a secure protocol that gives AI agents a single way to sign transactions across every major blockchain 😯 

This is huge for agentic payments, and here's why: 

💥 Last year, @coinbase launched the x402 protocol to empower agents to perform transactions autonomously
💥 Stripe and Paradigm's MPP builds on x402
💥 @ethereumfndn's ERC-8004 clarifies how we can identify and trust agents.

Yet, neither specifies how the agent manages a wallet, private keys, or wallet signing. Until MoonPay's OWS 👏 

👉 And since I mentioned Stripe, an op-ed argues that MPP is the endgame for micropayments after decades of failed attempts. 

Why? Check the full article to find out 👀
https://web3plusai.xyz/daily_61
